copiar-datos.pain: We copy data by hand from one spreadsheet to another, or into another program.
copiar-datos.answer: I automate the transfer so nobody has to copy data by hand.
copiar-datos.tech: SQL Server · PostgreSQL · C# · data migration and automation
copiar-datos.message: copying data by hand from one spreadsheet to another

informe.pain: Every month we lose hours building the same report.
informe.answer: A dashboard that updates itself and makes sense at a glance.
informe.message: building the same report every month

pedidos.pain: Orders and requests reach us by email, phone and WhatsApp, and something always gets lost.
pedidos.answer: A custom web app where everything comes in through one place.
pedidos.tech: Vue 3 · TypeScript · ASP.NET Core · Entity Framework Core

conectar.pain: Our programs don't talk to each other.
conectar.answer: I connect them so information flows from one to the other on its own.
conectar.tech: ASP.NET Core · C# · layered REST APIs
conectar.message: our programs not talking to each other

renovar.pain: We have an old internal tool nobody dares to touch.
renovar.answer: I rebuild it in parts, one module at a time.
renovar.tech: Micro-frontends with Vue 3 and Module Federation · Vite

excel.pain: We depend on a huge spreadsheet only one person understands.
excel.answer: I turn it into a simple app with users and permissions, so it doesn't depend on any one person.
excel.tech: Vue 3 · ASP.NET Core · SQL Server · Azure
excel.message: depending on a huge spreadsheet only one person understands

about.bio1: I'm Dani, a full stack developer. I live in Santa Coloma de Gramenet (Barcelona) and have spent more than five years building software for companies.
about.bio2: I take care of what you see on screen, what drives it underneath, and the data that feeds it.

case.title: A real case
case.body: Since September 2021 I've been a full stack developer at Unex, an industrial electrical-equipment manufacturer. There I build the team's internal applications, the connections between their programs, and the automation and migration of their data.

apps.value: Built in modules, with Vue 3 micro-frontends and Module Federation.

connections.value: REST APIs with ASP.NET Core 10, EF Core and SQL Server, in versioned layers.
